title: SilentLightningFix
description: Fixes an issue where if lightning had the silent NBT tag it still made noise.
body:
# SilentLightingFix

SilentLightningFix is a mod for Minecraft that fixes a weird bug where if lightning has the `Silent` NBT tag set to true, it would still make noise, this fixes it using Mixin, allowing other mod developers, builders, and server owners to use lightning as an effect, without the noise.
